entities.summary: Ludwig Johann Wilhelm Gruno, Hereditary Prince of Hesse-Homburg was hereditary prince of Hesse-Homburg, member of the House of Hesse and an Imperial Russian field marshal in the service of Empress Elizabeth of Russia.
